title: Member Accounts Q&A: Kestrel Care Rewards Level and Charges Retained on Cancelled Delivery & Pickup Services Orders
content:
**How does a Kestrel Care Rewards level affect the charges retained when a Delivery & Pickup Services order is cancelled before dispatch?**

The retained cancellation charges are added together, and that sum is then adjusted for the patient's Kestrel Care Rewards membership in active status. The cancellation refund is the speed fee charged on the cancelled order less the retained cancellation charges as adjusted for the rewards level, never below zero and rounded to the cent.

**What share of the retained sum is kept at each level?**

| Patient's active Kestrel Care Rewards level | Retained sum kept | Rounding of the kept amount |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 50 percent | rounded down to the cent |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 75 percent | rounded up to the cent |
| any other level, or no active membership | the whole sum | none needed |

**Can you show the working?** Hypothetical retained charges totalling $4.50 on an express fee of $12.99:

| Level | Retained sum kept | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Rewards Platinum | 50 percent of 4.50 is $2.25 | 12.99 less 2.25 is $10.74 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Gold | 75 percent of 4.50 is 3.375, rounded up to $3.38 | 12.99 less 3.38 is $9.61 |
| Kestrel Care Rewards Member | $4.50 | 12.99 less 4.50 is $8.49 |

With retained charges totalling $2.25, a Platinum member keeps 1.125 rounded down to $1.12 and a Gold member 1.6875 rounded up to $1.69.

**Can the refund go below zero?** No. Hypothetically, on a speed fee of $2.00 with $4.50 retained and no rewards adjustment, the refund is $0.00.
